text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building reliable backend and web application features. I’d be glad to help add Amazon SP API integration to your Spring Boot application so you can pull inventory and orders data and store it in your MySQL database for the next phase of your product.

My background includes backend work, API integration, and building systems that move and store data cleanly. In a recent project for Quillstack, I built the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token by token, and the system reached first token on screen in about 600 ms. That project reinforced how important it is to design responsive, dependable integrations that handle data flow smoothly.

I also worked on a subscription box billing backend for Fernwood Pantry, where I moved subscribers off a legacy plugin onto Stripe Billing and added a retry queue for failed card payments. That work supported the migration of 6.5k subscribers and helped recover 31% of failed payments. It gave me more experience with backend reliability, scheduled processing, and keeping data accurate across systems.

For your job, I would focus only on the backend as requested. I can help wire up the Amazon SP API endpoints needed to retrieve inventory information and orders information, transform the responses as needed, and persist the results into your MySQL tables. I’m comfortable working with REST APIs, backend data models, and building maintainable integration layers that can be extended later when you’re ready for the front end.

I’d approach this carefully to make sure the data retrieval, mapping, and database writes are structured cleanly and are easy to maintain going forward. Since you’re planning a second phase for the UI, I would keep the backend implementation organized so it’s straightforward to reuse later.

If you’d like, I can help you get this backend integration in place and ready for future front-end development.
